messages:
maya_ops: Heads-up: we're seeing sustained GPU pod allocation failures in ca-central-1 since 14:00 UTC. Scheduler reports OOMs + failed attaches. Impact: latency spikes and queued requests for customers on Dedicated.
jonah_infra: seeing increased eviction rates on node pool ca-central-gpu-2, kernel logs show nvlink re-enumeration errors.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2023-2049 | Severity: P2 | Assigned: oncall-ravi
ravi_sre: I'm on it. Can we confirm if reserve/hedge pool was warmed? Maya, any recent scale-downs?
maya_ops: reserve-pool was scaled down last night to 0 due to cost tag cleanup. didn't re-warm on policy change.
elena_prod: customer-facing: a few requests time out. routing fallback to lower-tier models is active but not covering throughput.
priya_reliability: proposal: add a "hedge-warm" step to the failover playbook: keep 2-3 pre-warmed nodes per region with 0.5 QPS guard. reduces cold start but adds cost.
sebastian_platform: also suggest a traffic-shepherd script to gradually shift traffic with health checks and cost ceiling.
ravi_sre: rough commands I used to shift traffic manually:
```
shift-traffic --from ca-central-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 40 --health-check /healthz
```
jonah_infra: that worked for the hotfix, but we need automation for throttles and rollback if latency > 300ms.
maya_ops: agreed. running a post-incident runbook change: add steps for "pre-warm hedge" + "incremental shepherd shift" + threshold values.
priya_reliability: cost guard: add a daily budget cap for cross-region bursting. if exceeded, auto-fallback to quantized model variant.
sebastian_platform: I'll add dashboard tiles: reserve pool utilization, cross-region egress cost, shift cooldown timers.
ravi_sre: action items: maya -> update runbook doc and playbook YAML; jonah -> add gpu-eviction metrics alerts; sebastian -> dashboard; priya -> budget guard PR. ETA EOD tomorrow.
maya_ops: starting runbook draft now. adding checklist and example commands + ribbon to oncall bot to run shepherd.
jonah_infra: pushed alert: gpu.eviction.rate > 0.5% > 5m -> pager; added notes to incident timeline.
elena_prod: will keep customers updated. thumbs up on hedge pool.
maya_ops: next steps: add unit test for shift script in ci, and add cost estimate template. tagging owners in the runbook.
oncall-bot: NOTE: Runbook updated draft created by maya_ops. Link: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/ca-central-hedge-draft
priya_reliability: :thumbsup: let's also schedule a dry-run next week to validate shepherd and budget behavior.
maya_ops: good. closing incident for now, monitoring 1h. follow-up retro meeting tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
